punchline: Paris sent its own taxis to the Marne, and they moved more morale than men.
thirty_sec: In early September 1914 General Gallieni requisitioned Paris taxis, 630 by the Army Museum's count, to carry soldiers of two infantry regiments toward the Marne front; they moved few men next to the railways but became a symbol of French resistance.
question: Which small, visible action using only what you already have could you take this week to show work has begun?
key_contrast: The taxis moved little material and a lot of morale.
